diagnosis.primary: The actual 8K atmospheric capture completion interval exceeded the shared 150-second UHD operation deadline by about10 seconds; drawing demonstrably completed shortly after the timeout.
diagnosis.secondary: The test finally restored RENDERMODE_CONTINUOUSLY while failed ultraEntry had not reverted the 8K atmosphere state. This allowed another expensive draw to delay final GL reporting and add a second 150-second timeout.
diagnosis.limits: No thread dump proves every instant of scheduling; the 159.88-second completed GL swap, screenshot and source control flow support a slow completed operation and a reporting scheduling defect, not a persistent renderer deadlock.
